rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality day-5 blastocyst with compact ICM, generally cohesive TE, thinned zona, and limited certainty from a single soft-focused image; slightly hedges against the reported 4AA/hatching appearance but avoids major fabrication.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrial thickness, male-factor diagnosis, BMI, first-cycle status, sperm parameters, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, with probability estimates and recommendations flowing from the case data; minor tension exists between calling the embryo 4AA-compatible yet not clearly top-tier by image alone.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and avoiding overreaction after one failure; minor overreach includes speculative comments on sperm DNA fragmentation and optional PGT-A framing without deeper nuance.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, transfer optimization, expectation setting, and escalation only after repeated failures.
